atLarge.quote: While all county voters will vote for the three at-large districts, to serve as the first, second or third at-large district County Legislator you must reside within the boundaries of that at-large district.

charter.quote: One member shall reside in and be nominated and elected by the qualified voters in each district; and one member shall reside in each district at large and be nominated and elected by the qualified voters of the county at large.

jcebJurisdiction.sourceOrg: Jackson County Board of Election Commissioners
jcebJurisdiction.quote: The Jackson County Election Board is the election authority for Jackson County, Missouri outside the corporate limits of Kansas City, Missouri.

kcebJurisdiction.quote: Serving the Voters of Kansas City within Jackson County
